title: Cursor Flaw Lets Malicious Cloned Repositories Trigger Windows Code Execution
summary: Open a repository in Cursor on Windows and, if a file named git.exe is sitting in the project root, Cursor runs it. No click, no approval dialog, no warning that anything in the folder is about to execute.
card_summary: Open a repository in Cursor on Windows and, if a file named git.exe is sitting in the project root, Cursor runs it. No click, no approval dialog, no warning that anything in the folder is about to execute.

sections.technical: Whatever that binary does, it does as you, with your source, your SSH keys and your cloud tokens.

title: Compromised AsyncAPI npm Packages Deliver Multi-Stage Botnet Malware
summary: Four compromised npm packages in the @asyncapi namespace have been observed distributing a multi-stage botnet loader, according to findings from OX Security, SafeDep, Socket, and StepSecurity.
card_summary: Four compromised npm packages in the @asyncapi namespace have been observed distributing a multi-stage botnet loader, according to findings from OX Security, SafeDep, Socket, and StepSecurity.

sections.context: This fits the broader data-exposure trend where follow-on abuse of leaked information is common.

title: Microsoft Patches Record 622 Flaws, Including Two Zero-Days Under Active Attack
summary: Microsoft shipped its largest Patch Tuesday on record today, and two of the fixes close holes that attackers are already exploiting. The release covers 622 of Microsoft's own CVEs by its Security Update Guide count, more than triple June's previous high of around 200.
